verdict.rationale: The MI355X is a datacenter AI/HPC accelerator: 288GB HBM3E, ROCm, Kubernetes and Slurm tooling, and comparisons against B200/B300. High-refresh 4K gaming is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the card ships any gaming or display capability, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
